general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing_attribute_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format (e.g. data-testid="login-submit-button", data-testid="kpi-card-exceptions").
general_ui_ux_guidelines.color_rules: Never use pure #000000. Use slate-950 (#090D16). Never use single color for status without icon or text label.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_states: Always specify explicit hover colors (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.contrast_standards: Ensure high text contrast meeting APCA/WCAG standards against dark surfaces.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this design system strictly. Use React components with Tailwind CSS.
Ensure the application supports both public marketing views and authenticated RegTech SaaS views.
Every button, input, card, table row, and tab MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Maintain monospace code showcase aesthetic for technical proof panels.
